summary: Publish canonical Fractal release archives with temporary Smalltalk compatibility copies.

replay.detail: Release archive naming does not change claim replay or projections.

schema.detail: No database schema or storage version change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule or fleet coordination change.

compatibility.detail: New releases publish fractal-<target>.tar.gz and checksums. Until 2026-11-01 they also publish smalltalk-<target>.tar.gz copies with the historical root directory and matching payloads. The download installer prefers canonical names and falls back to the historical name only on HTTP 404, supporting retained pre-rename releases without masking other HTTP failures. Runtime binaries, wire formats and historical release bytes are unchanged.

downtime.detail: Archive publication and isolated installation checks do not restart running services.

manual.detail: Direct archive consumers should select fractal-<target>.tar.gz for new releases before compatibility copies end on 2026-11-01. Retained pre-rename tags still use smalltalk-<target>.tar.gz. Users of install.sh need no additional step.

recovery.detail: Continue to install retained historical tags through install.sh or their original archive names; this change does not rewrite historical releases or durable state.
